Script.code:
local xi, yi, cxi, cyi 
local vw, vh = 8, 12

function onCreate()
  xi = my.layout.x
  yi = my.layout.y
  local cam = castle.actorsWithTag("camera")[1]
  cxi = cam.layout.x 
  cyi = cam.layout.y
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  local cx, cy 
  local cam = castle.actorsWithTag("camera")[1]
  if cam ~= nil then 
    cx = cam.layout.x 
    cy = cam.layout.y
    local vx = (cx - cxi) * my.variables.scale
    local vy = (cy - cyi) * my.variables.scale
    my.layout.x = xi + vx
    my.layout.y = yi + vy
    while my.layout.x < cx - vw do my.layout.x = my.layout.x + vw * 2 end 
    while my.layout.y < cy - vh do my.layout.y = my.layout.y + vh * 2 end 
    while my.layout.x > cx + vw do my.layout.x = my.layout.x - vw * 2 end 
    while my.layout.y > cy + vh do my.layout.y = my.layout.y - vh * 2 end 
  end 
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor)
  if message == "tiles" then
    local camX = my.layout.x
    local camY = my.layout.y
    
    for i = -8, 8, 4 do
      for j = -12, 12, 4 do
        local tileX = camX + i
        local tileY = camY + j
        castle.createActor("bg-tile", tileX, tileY)
      end
    end
  end
end

function onCreate() end

function onUpdate(dt)
  local god = castle.actorsWithTag("god")[1]
  -- my.text.content = string.format("%10.1f", god.variables.time)
  my.text.content = tostring(god.variables.taps)
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor)
end

local labels = {
  "NEXT LEVEL ->",
  "TRY AGAIN?",
  "LEADERBOARD"
}

function onCreate()
  
end

function onUpdate(dt)
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor)
  if message == "ready" then
    my.text.content = labels[my.variables.idx + 1]
    my.layout.visible = true
  elseif message == "tap" then 
    if my.variables.idx == 1 then
      local ls = castle.actorsWithTag("local-hero-lifecycle")
      for _, actor in ipairs(ls) do
        actor:addTag("ready")
      end
    elseif my.variables.idx == 0 then 
      local next = castle.actorsWithTag("next")[1]
      next:addTag("ready")
    elseif my.variables.idx == 2 then 
      castle.sendTriggerMessage("leaderboard")
    elseif my.variables.idx == 3 then
      castle.sendTriggerMessage("menu")
    end
  end
end

local val = ""
local lerp = 1
local t = 0

function onCreate()
  val = my.text.content
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  t = t + dt
  local p = val
  if t > 0.02 then 
    if lerp > 0 then 
      for i = 1, #val do 
        local c = val:sub(i,i)
        local r
        if math.random() < lerp then 
          r = string.char(math.random(32,126))
        else
          r = c 
        end 
        p = string.sub(p, 1, i - 1) .. r .. string.sub(p, i + 1)
      end 
      lerp = lerp - my.variables.vel
    end 
    t = 0
    my.text.content = p
  end 
end

function onMessage(message, triggeringActor)
end

  end

local xi, yi, cxi, cyi 
local vw, vh = 8, 12

function onCreate()
  xi = my.layout.x
  yi = my.layout.y
  local cam = castle.actorsWithTag("camera")[1]
  cxi = cam.layout.x 
  cyi = cam.layout.y
end

function onUpdate(dt)
  local cx, cy 
  local cam = castle.actorsWithTag("camera")[1]
  if cam ~= nil then 
    cx = cam.layout.x 
    cy = cam.layout.y
    local vx = (cx - cxi) * my.variables.scale
    local vy = (cy - cyi) * my.variables.scale
    my.layout.x = xi + vx
    my.layout.y = yi + vy
    while my.layout.x < cx - vw do my.layout.x = my.layout.x + vw * 2 end 
    while my.layout.y < cy - vh do my.layout.y = my.layout.y + vh * 2 end 
    while my.layout.x > cx + vw do my.layout.x = my.layout.x - vw * 2 end 
    while my.layout.y > cy + vh do my.layout.y = my.layout.y - vh * 2 end 
  end 
end
